cross_product_finding: Not access-control- or edition-shaped at all: this page is a pure API-surface-parity table between CBL's own two query front-ends (fluent QueryBuilder vs. SQL++ string). It has no counterpart in the server/ or Capella batches, which (per the registry) were organized around privilege/role/billing gates rather than 'which of our two client APIs supports this query feature'. Notably, the gap runs in only one direction except for two named features (Predictive Query, Index) that are QueryBuilder-exclusive and unavailable from SQL++ strings at all - consistent with query-n1ql-mobile-server-diffs.md's statement that CREATE INDEX is 'Not Supported' in SQL++ for Mobile.
